title: Resource capacity
subtitle: Available capacity and initiative demand per resourcing role and month, in full-time equivalents (FTE).

grid.title: Capacity by role and month
grid.intro: Demand counts planned and committed demand of initiatives that are not cancelled or completed.
grid.caption: Capacity grid: available, demand and committed FTE per role and month
grid.noConflicts: No over-allocated cell among the months with known capacity.
grid.rule: A conflict means demand is above the available capacity; the shortfall is demand minus available. A month without a capacity row is Unknown, never treated as enough capacity.
grid.emptyBody: Capacity appears once resourcing roles and capacity are recorded.

demands.title: Resource demand
demands.intro: Initiative demand per role and month. Committing a demand records the capacity owner's commitment.
demands.caption: Resource demands
demands.releaseBody: The demand no longer counts against capacity.
demands.notApproval: Committing capacity is a resourcing commitment, not a business approval.
demands.editBody: Only a planned demand can be changed. A committed demand is released first.

edit.fteHint: Full-time equivalents as a decimal, for example 1.50 (Latin digits, a dot, at most 2 decimals).

roles.title: Resourcing roles
roles.intro: Resourcing roles (for example 'Data engineer') are planning roles, not access roles. An archived role keeps its history but takes no new capacity or demand.
roles.caption: Resourcing roles
roles.codeHint: Lower-case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter (for example data_engineer). It cannot be changed later.
roles.archiveBody: The role and its history are kept. No new capacity or demand can be recorded for it.

rows.title: Capacity rows
rows.intro: Available capacity per role and month. A month without a capacity row is Unknown, never treated as enough capacity.
rows.caption: Capacity rows: available FTE per role and month
rows.addTitle: Add capacity for a role and month

problem.resource_role__code_taken: A resourcing role with this code already exists in this transformation.
problem.resource_role__archived: This resourcing role is archived: it takes no new capacity or demand.
problem.capacity__duplicate: This role already has capacity recorded for this month. Edit that row instead.
problem.resource_demand__not_planned: Only a planned resource demand can be changed or committed.
problem.resource_demand__not_committed: Only a committed resource demand can be released.
problem.resource_demand__release_first: A committed resource demand must be released before it is archived.
problem.initiative__read_only: A cancelled or completed initiative is read-only; its resource demand can no longer be changed.
